segments.name: Peruvian operations
segments.description: Mines copper at the Toquepala and Cuajone complexes and processes it into anodes and refined copper for customers worldwide, with molybdenum and silver by-products.
segments.evidence: 1. Peruvian operations, which include the Toquepala and Cuajone mine complexes and the smelting and refining plants, including a precious metals plant, industrial railroad and port facilities that service both mines.

segments.name: Mexican open-pit operations
segments.description: Mines and processes ore from the La Caridad and Buenavista complexes into copper, zinc, molybdenum and silver sold to customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: 2. Mexican open-pit operations, which include the La Caridad and Buenavista mine complexes and the smelting and refining plants, including a precious metals plant and a copper rod plant and support facilities that service both mines.

segments.name: Mexican underground mining operations
segments.description: Runs five underground mines and a zinc refinery, producing zinc, copper, lead, silver and gold; known internally as the IMMSA unit.
segments.evidence: 3. Mexican underground mining operations, which include five underground mines that produce zinc, copper, lead, silver and gold; and a zinc refinery.

revenueModel.text: End-user customers pay for copper, molybdenum, silver and zinc bought mostly under annual or longer-term contracts at prevailing commodity prices.
revenueModel.evidence: We focus on end-user customers as opposed to selling on the spot market or to trading companies.
